items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Well, that's Esther Bijou's brother, and Esther Bijou is a cousin, a second or first cousin to Isidore -- Isidore Barbarin, Paul's father.

ctx.x: Esther Bijou and Boy Bijou. That's her brother. Boy Bijou playd kazoo and the clarinet. He was a ballroom musician, played the ballroom with a band called the Rootie-Dooty sometimes.
